Maya: Heads-up — LatticeBridge private VPC deploy is scheduled for Tue 2024-04-30 01:00-03:00 UTC. Primary work: DB schema migration + model package update. Need owners for each step.
Jordan: I can own the migration + smoke verification for the model service. Will be ready by 00:30 UTC.
Sam: I'll own ingress/routing cutover and run perf smoke. Need someone to hold rollback and watch logs.
Priya: I can be rollback lead and monitor logs & metrics. I'll also run post-deploy health checks.
Maya: Quick checklist (short):
  - freeze deploy branch 30m prior
  - infra snapshot/prebackups
  - canary to 5% first
  - smoke perf + correctness tests
  - scale to full capacity if green
Anyone want to add?
Jordan: Add: set cache TTL to 0 during cutover to avoid stale responses. Also post migration SQL in thread before window.
Sam: Perf smoke command I'll run locally:```bash
# 30s perf smoke against canary
siege -c50 -t30S 'https://canary.latticebridge.internal/api/generate'
```Requesting timeouts: 60s per request, 2s token latency expectation.
Priya: Rollback plan quick notes:
  1) stop traffic to new nodes
  2) run `rbctl restore --snapshot=pre-deploy-1732109876`
  3) revert routing tag `rb:stable` -> `rb:previous`
  4) confirm consumer checkpoints reset
I'll be on pager & phone.
Maya: Signoffs so far: Maya (coord), Jordan (migration + service smoke), Sam (ingress + perf), Priya (rollback + logs). @deploy-bot please schedule the quiet window and reserve maintenance lane 02:00-04:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: latticebridge-vpc | 2024-04-30 01:00-03:00 UTC | Reserved lane: 02:00-04:00 UTC | Reminder: 30m prior :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Note — DB migration adds an index; low risk but could be long. I'll include `LOCK_TIMEOUT=30s` and a progress script. Posting SQL below later tonight.
Maya: If anything looks off, abort and execute rollback plan. Please document root cause here after. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll paste smoke results and a short perf summary into this thread after canary runs.
Priya: I'll be watching logs (elk: /apps/latticebridge/*) and metrics dashboard (dash: LB-vpc-prod). Phone: +1-555-0199.
Maya: Final ask: everyone add 15-min buffer after the window for post-checks and remediation. Thanks — see you in the channel during the window.
